title: US Address Checker & GPS Finder Input

addresses.title: US addresses
addresses.description: One full address per line, e.g. 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC. You can paste thousands, they are checked in bulk.

includeAreaInfo.title: Include area info
includeAreaInfo.description: Also return the county, official city or town, congressional district and census tract for each address.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on addresses checked. Controls total cost. First 2 rows per run are free; addresses that cannot be found are always free.
